address: Klippans Kulturreservat, Adolf Edelsvärds gata 5, Gothenburg, 414 51, Sweden
bio: A charming split-level restaurant in an old 1775 East India Company warehouse; sit on the upper floor to take in the lovely harbour view. Cooking offers a pleasing mix of classic and modern dishes, with seafood kept to the fore. The wine list offers a good selection of top burgundies....
